name: Sülysáp (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of white, blue and white in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the town arms of Sülysáp (a green shield with a yellow tree, ears of grain, a wavy stripe and a church) below the name SÜLYSÁP in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
